Adolion: The Adventurer's Road
Author view
Overview
Memory
⚑
Where you are
What Waits in the Roots
Where the mine cut into the roots, the Lord Spirit looms over the clearing among the ones it has taken.
Things are close to breaking.
About this story
You have just signed on at the Adventurer's Guild in Aegis City, with no party yet. Belle, a headstrong barbarian, and Dalan, a shy elf ranger, are looking for one too. The postings on the board are small, the pay is modest, and every rank has to be earned. Expect frontier fantasy with a dark edge: real danger, mysteries that open one clue at a time, and choices that cost something. Bring any adventurer you like; the Guild takes all kinds.
Recently
You left Into Needlehaven behind and moved into What Waits in the Roots.
Open threads
The echoing non-human voice near the oak has now spoken aloud, and the party must decide whether to answer it.
What Duggy 'knows' and why the Lord Spirit wanted him brought remains unexplained.
Whether the miners can be restored from the white flowers, or are lost, is unresolved.
The Lord Spirit has been shot by Dalan and has not reacted, leaving the party to face an unkillable-seeming guardian that has declared itself hurt and hostile.
The party must decide whether to fight, flee, or try to address the Lord Spirit's hurt now that violence has been initiated.
The story so far
Max Nightriver, Belle, and Dalan formed the Grey Pennants at the Adventurers' Guild in Aegis City, where Ellie registered the party and Max accepted the Wendhope contract despite Tobias's warning that it was an A-rank problem downgraded to D-rank. The party left at first light with rope, lanterns, and extra rations, traveling north past abandoned villages, carts, horses, and dead bodies with flesh gone and eyes gouged out, until they reached the walled mining village of Wendhope. Refused entry at first, Max negotiated with the defenders and secured passage through the west postern.

1 thing the story picked up — they take effect on the next turn.
Following along.
